summary_en: 34,672,400 shares (1.86% of shares outstanding) to be acquired on 2026-07-30 via ToSTNeT-3 at closing price of ¥5,690/share; total consideration ¥197.3B. Part of Fully Committed Share Repurchase programme authorized 2026-04-28 with ¥250B upper limit and 45M share authorization.
title_en: Notice Regarding Share Buyback via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Shin-Etsu Chemical announced on 2026-07-29 a block acquisition of 34,672,400 shares (1.86% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be executed on 2026-07-30 via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) at the closing price of ¥5,690 per share, for a total of ¥197.3 billion. This block trade represents execution within a Fully Committed Share Repurchase (FCSR) programme authorized by the board on 2026-04-28 with an aggregate upper limit of ¥250 billion and a maximum of 45 million shares (2.42% of shares outstanding). The buyback order is placed for the single trading session commencing 08:45 JST on 2026-07-30 and is conditional on matching sell orders; the company will announce results after the trading window closes. The acquisition is not contingent on market conditions, though partial or non-execution remains possible in the event of insufficient seller interest.
